title: Retired USAF colonel David flies a craft

tellings.quote: And and he just tells a story. I'm on a craft. He says, "I suddenly find myself on a craft."

plain: Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, passes on a story he says he heard from a retired US Air Force colonel named David, in Orange County, California. According to Cameron, David said he "suddenly found himself on a craft" and ended up flying it. If true, it would mean a human was put at the controls of a non-human vehicle.
